svg.aria-label: How Starfold works. A table of measurements, one row per star, is drawn as a map by UMAP. HDBSCAN cuts the dense clumps of the map into groups and leaves sparse stars unassigned; settings for both are searched and scored without labels. Refits on random subsets show which stars and groups come back: stars fade where the refits disagree. The marks are from a recorded run on APOGEE stars.
